workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI validation proof IAU candidate

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority can report validation readback facts but has no public requirements import, Spec Kit feature, admission record, proof JSON writer, issue-body generator, or public proof redaction contract for vihs --validate --proof-out.

splitDecision.reason: Validation proof-artifact generation is smaller than no-argument interactive selection and does not require runtime execution. It can retain validation readback facts as public-safe artifacts without starting LabVIEWCLI, Docker, compare execution, packaging, or Marketplace behavior.
doNotAdmitTogether: live already-running VS Code session uptake proof

allowed: package identity vi-history / VI History / svelderrainruiz / MIT / 0.1.0
validation proof fields for runtime outcome, provider, engine, blocked reason, error code, proof status, and implementation status
persisted provider, LabVIEW version, LabVIEW bitness, and effective settings target facts already established by validation readback
deterministic issue-body text targeting the MIT public authority unless a later governing decision redirects proof intake
public-safe host and environment facts with secret-like environment values redacted
blocked: private evidence roots or local filesystem paths
credentials, token names, or release credentials
source-copying instructions from another VI History authority
private proof packets or private issue templates
live already-running VS Code session uptake proof
VSIX packaging, Marketplace publication, or release automation

candidateImplementationWork: add tests proving a validation result can be retained as structured proof JSON without starting runtime execution
add tests proving secret-like environment values are redacted from public proof output
add tests proving the generated issue body is deterministic and points to the MIT public authority
implement the minimum public MIT proof-artifact writer for supplied validation readback facts
nextGate: Create the public MIT import packet and Spec Kit feature for runtime-settings-cli-validation-proof-v1, then run redaction and artifact validation before any IAU preflight can admit implementation.
